tests.command: PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/ -x -q -k 'plateau or evox or restart or diversity or normalize'

evox_runner.py: Both _run_nsga2_fallback and _run_nsga3: multi-gen post-restart mutation boost (was one-shot)
phase2_rule_pool.py: run_epoch: clears global_metrics_cache for seeded keys on non-first epoch
run_epoch: caps hall-of-fame to PHASE2_HOF_EPOCH_CARRYOVER entries
diversity penalty: auto-scales Hamming threshold when AUTO=True

notes_for_reviewer: The _hamming_distance function was duplicated in evox_runner.py (local copy for _select_diverse_subset) to avoid circular import issues.
test_mutation_boost_capped_at_0_6 test is preserved but tests the old multiplier-based boost formula; it's not directly related to the new fixed-rate boost approach but doesn't conflict.
The old one-shot _plateau_restart_boost variable has been removed entirely from both loops.
Run_epoch clearing: only non-first epochs with seed_chromosomes trigger cache clearing.
Rank-based normalization uses manual average-rank computation (no scipy dependency).
